description: Reviewed facsimile repairs for the 2026-10-13 Tomi I-III and Tomus VI gap/split/skew work. Each `repairs` record pins one source-scoped fix identified by `disposition`: a `mask` whitens a Greek/Latin divider or scan-edge streak so the Latin column bands normally; a `shear` straightens a uniformly tilted scan with an integer per-column vertical shift before banding; a `row_excision` deletes reviewed blank rows after shear so a source chapter gap becomes an ordinary reader gap; a `whole_strip` wraps a reviewed cut-point strip whole instead of letting the composer fill-split it across a page break; a `source_body_band` re-adds a reviewed body line that a full-unit boundary trim dropped after banding, keyed by the cropped column dimensions and the exact observed/protected band; a `word_patch` restores real source pixels of a glyph the crop dropped; and `source_spacing_retained` records a genuine gap that is left unchanged. Every record carries source identity, raw dimensions, and reviewed Latin regions that must survive byte-identically. Mask coordinates are normalized full-source fractions matching SOURCE_FURNITURE_MASKS unless `coordinate_space` is `sheared`; shear records carry the raw fingerprint, matched gap rows, `x0_px`, `baseline_slope`, shift range, and padding; whole-strip records carry the cropped column dimensions, the exact band, and the strip fingerprint. The top-level `diagnoses` array is measurement-phase evidence only and is not installed: only `repairs` records drive production.

diagnoses.baseline_symptom: III. Ceterum chapter opening is displaced and left-gutter fragments appear.
diagnoses.evidence: Matched gaps descend right; crop bands merge [907,2633], and the divider overlaps glyphs. Straighten before banding; remeasure crop and body filtering after shear.

composer_diagnosis.evidence: The III. Ceterum heading band [2149,2186] survives both passes and is placed on canvas 3, so this is not a dropped line. The defect is a 271px chapter-break blank between the preceding body line [1840,1878] and the heading (ordinary inter-line gap ~14px). The heading's cut-point strip [2013,2190] carries ~135px of that leading blank, which composes as the visible gap before the heading -- a band-level oversized-blank case (i), not a composer page-fill artifact. A page-scoped SOURCE_ROW_EXCISIONS on (0,34) deleting most of the post-shear blank (~[1892,2135], leaving an ordinary gap) normalizes it; remeasure the p34 band_source_column crop guard and bands afterward.

diagnoses.baseline_symptom: Inflated gap after sed propter victoriam and Greek fragments in left margin.
diagnoses.evidence: The initially paired left interval [868,886) belonged to the next line's gap and gave the wrong slope sign. The corrected same-line gaps rise to the right; the tested positive slope separates the merged bands. The original crop reaches the raw right edge.

composer_diagnosis.victory_line: subito illis nihil tale exspectantibus, sed propter victoriam
composer_diagnosis.evidence: p448 is an interior page (unit start 439) and the victory line is its first body line. Its post-shear band [330,366] survives render_and_band (Pass A) -- which is why philopoemen_victory_line_deskewed, a Pass-A single-page test, still asserts it -- but the full-unit Pass B removes it: drop_interior_running_head drops the first band as a running-head remnant, so it never becomes a strip (became_strip=false) and is absent from all 31 canvases, and the reader jumps straight to 'secure agentibus' [380,415]. The prior note (band dropped) and the current Pass-A test (band present) describe different stages, not a contradiction. The Pass-B rescue retain_known_source_body_bands(Some("philopoemen")) re-adds record.protected when the pre-trim observed bands contain it, so a SOURCE_BODY_BANDS entry (0,448,(1079,3068)) with observed=protected=[330,366] restores the line.

diagnoses.baseline_symptom: quidem passus Callisthenem is fill-split across reader pp86/87: the Tall strip [2224,2317] straddles canvases 78 and 79.
diagnoses.evidence: Superseded by composer_diagnosis: the composer fill-splits the complete Tall strip [2224,2317] across canvases 78/79, so wrap it whole.

composer_diagnosis.evidence: The composer-level trace reproduces the straddle the band-domain check could not see: quidem passus Callisthenem bands as a complete Tall strip [2224,2317] (112 scaled px) but the packer fill-splits it at a low-ink row to finish canvas 78 (reader p86) and places the remainder on canvas 79 (p87). The whole strip fits a fresh body budget (112 <= 1394). Add [2224,2317] to WHOLE_STRIPS (fingerprint 29bcac...) so it wraps whole; this supersedes the earlier no_repair_required disposition.

diagnoses.baseline_symptom: Right crop clips endings of sive, praeter, (3), auferro, and idem; Greek bleeds left.
diagnoses.evidence: Matched gaps rise right; the baseline crop ends at x1708 while sive reaches x1720. Shear may change the detected crop; check every right glyph after shear before considering a source-pixel word patch.

diagnoses.baseline_symptom: The installed whole_strip closes the original consi-/lioque split but injects a 741px page-bottom gap on reader p394 after 'agerentur pensitantis'.
diagnoses.evidence: The source consi-/lioque inter-line gap is 20 px at x [950,1050) and 18 px at x [1550,1650). The 815-px Tall strip spans both lines, fits a full 1394-px page after scaling, and its fill-split places them on reader pp394-395. Wrapping the reviewed strip whole is indicated; no source gap needs removal.

composer_diagnosis.bridge_test: Masking edge columns (x[1620,1698) or x[880,925)) raises true blank rows only 24->31 and leaves 2-4 blank runs; no removable non-Latin bridge separates the lines.
composer_diagnosis.evidence: The installed whole-strip [1022,1837] (980 scaled px) wraps a merged ~20-line block onto canvas 41, leaving a 741px page-bottom gap on canvas 40 after 'agerentur pensitantis' -- far beyond two median strip heights (~96px). The block merges because p398 is skewed (~0.024 slope: a line top is 1031 at x~1010 but 1050 at x~1590), so tilted baselines leave no full-width blank rows and no edge-column mask separates them. A lossless shear (slope 0.02414, x0 1350) restores 20 separate blank-row runs. Fix with a SOURCE_SHEARS entry on (1,398) and REMOVAL of the [1022,1837] whole-strip entry, not a bridge mask.
